title: Adaptive Hybrid Particle Swarm Optimization with Gradient Descent
abstract: arXiv:2608.11258v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Gradient injection helps Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) only when the swarm has identified a basin with smooth local structure, not universally. We propose Adaptive Hybrid PSO (AHPSO), which uses a sigmoid function on swarm diversity to automatically modulate gradient influence: near-zero during exploration, near-maximum during exploitation, with no manual phase-switching. Under budget-normalized comparison (PSO given equivalent total function evaluations), PSO wins 52.5% of 40 configurations versus AHPSO's 20% (p = 7.0e-5, Friedman). AHPSO retains advantage specifically on problems with smooth local basins (F8, F24-F27) where directed descent outperforms undirected sampling even at equal cost. Under iteration-matched comparison across 29 functions (42 configurations, 14,700 runs), AHPSO-Adadelta ranks first of 9 methods including CMA-ES (p = 9.75e-4). translated_title: 自适应混合粒子群优化与梯度下降
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.11258v1 公告类型：新 摘要：梯度注入仅在粒子群优化（PSO）识别出具有平滑局部结构的盆地时才有帮助，并非普遍适用。我们提出了自适应混合PSO（AHPSO），它利用群体多样性的S形函数自动调节梯度影响：在探索阶段接近零，在开发阶段接近最大，无需手动切换阶段。在预算归一化比较下（PSO获得等效的总函数评估次数），PSO在40种配置中胜出52.5%，而AHPSO仅胜出20%（p = 7.0e-5，弗里德曼检验）。AHPSO在具有平滑局部盆地的问题（F8、F24-F27）上特别保持优势，在这些问题上，即使在相同成本下，定向下降也优于无定向采样。在29个函数、42种配置、14,700次运行的迭代匹配比较中，AHPSO-Adadelta在包括CMA-ES在内的9种方法中排名第一（p = 9.75e-4）。其贡献在于对梯度注入何时提供优势进行了原理性刻画。
tldr: 提出了一种自适应混合粒子群优化方法，通过群体多样性自动调节梯度影响，在平滑局部盆地问题上优于传统PSO，并提供了梯度注入有效性的原理性分析。
en_tdlr: Proposes an adaptive hybrid PSO that automatically modulates gradient influence via swarm diversity, outperforming standard PSO on smooth local basin problems and providing a principled characterization of when gradient injection is beneficial.
